time_semantics: UTC server timestamps; started_at <= server_time < ends_at; no automatic store enrollment

cases.name: existing_account_backfill
cases.rule: started_at equals immutable original account created_at, ends_at exactly 30 days later; migration time never resets the period

cases.name: verified_store_precedence
cases.rule: base.access_source is store while its valid verified entitlement is active; cardless_trial remains separately visible

cases.name: reviewer
cases.rule: base.access_source remains review_complimentary and review_access true; cardless_trial remains separately visible; Bot mini reviewer treatment is unchanged

cases.name: bot_is_separate
cases.rule: active Base trial alone never activates Bot mini; stale Bot verification results in 503 for Bot use, not a fresh purchase prompt

cases.name: trial_with_stale_bot_verification
cases.rule: Base remains usable; Bot use returns purchase_verification_unavailable 503 and must not prompt a duplicate purchase.
